response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, experienced full-stack engineer with genuine systems-programming exposure (DLang low-latency services handling millions of requests/second) and strong testing culture, but falls well short of the core minimum qualification of 8 years of C++ — professional C++ experience appears limited to roughly seven months at National Instruments plus a thesis project. There is also no clear track record of formal technical leadership over cloud/DevOps teams or of owning large-scale compute platform strategy, making the profile a poor match for this specific tech-lead role despite solid general engineering credentials.
strengths: High-throughput distributed systems experience (micro-services handling millions of HTTP requests/sec at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic)
Strong software craftsmanship: TDD, CI/CD, testing tooling authorship, and open-source contributions
Broad, adaptable engineering background across backend, infrastructure (Kubernetes, Docker, AWS CDK), and mentoring via workshops and courses
concerns: Far short of the required 8 years of professional C++ experience (~7 months documented)
No formal technical-leadership title or evidence of leading cross-team strategy for a cloud compute platform
Recent experience is predominantly product/full-stack web (TypeScript/Node.js), not large-scale compute infrastructure

key_factors.factor: Lack of formal cloud technical-leadership track record
